query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arr, gather 'round, ye scallywags and sea dogs! Lend me yer ears and still yer grumblin' bellies for a moment!

We didn't brave the howlin' storms, the crackin' thunder, and the monstrous waves of the seven seas just to turn back now with empty hands and hollow hearts! No, by Davy Jones' locker, we did NOT!

Somewhere beyond that horizon lies a treasure so grand, so magnificent, that even the kings and queens of the mightiest empires would weep with envy at the sight of it! Gold doubloons piled high as the mast! Rubies and emeralds sparklin' like the stars we navigate by! Enough riches to buy yer own island and never swab another deck again!

I know the journey has been long. I know yer bones ache and yer spirits waver. But ask yerselves this — did the great pirates before us give up when the wind died and the seas went still? NEVER! They rowed if they had to! They CRAWLED if they had to! Because they knew, deep in their salty hearts, that fortune favors the BOLD!

Every one of ye signed on to this crew because ye had fire in yer eyes and hunger in yer soul! That fire doesn't go out just because the map is old and the path is treacherous! That fire is what GUIDES us!

So raise yer heads, tighten yer grips on those swords and shovels, and follow yer captain to glory! The treasure is out there, and by the kraken himself, WE are the ones who are going to FIND IT!

Now, what say ye?! ARE YE WITH ME?! ⚓🏴‍☠️
